_comment: Scheme names a question can be matched on (brief §66): the site's English information page slugs as phrases, plus aliases, minus generic slugs and ordinary-phrase titles. redact_feed.py tags each question with the longest phrase it contains, as the page address and category. hub = other pages sit beneath it, so a citation of any of them counts as a hit (brief §71). Public data: the site's own addresses. INTENTS carries the outcome the design expects per intent.
